projects.name: Tether
projects.description: A lightweight, extensible C99 user interface engine built on Entity Component System (ECS) architecture, format-independent scene parsing, the independent Vinyasa layout engine, and the Chitra 2D rendering subsystem.

plans.name: Tether 6-Month Full-Time Development Grant
plans.description: Six-month grant (INR 6.72L) funding full-time development of Tether, an extensible C99 ECS UI engine. M1: Core ECS optimization, modular memory, custom widgets/events. M2: Independent Vinyasa layout engine (Flex/Canvas presets). M3: Chitra rendering (SDL3, FreeType, HarfBuzz, BiDi). M4: Format-agnostic parser, automated Python/Rust bindings, CI merge gates, and tested release. Detailed plan: https://github.com/Yuvi-GD/Yuvi-GD/blob/main/funding-plan.md
